candidates.title: Family rallies behind Sask. teen, the lone survivor in crash that killed his grandparents and mother
candidates.description: On July 20, Alfred Pratt was one of four people in an SUV that crashed on Highway 1 near Piapot, in southwest Saskatchewan, and is the only one who came out of it alive. The crash killed his mother, Carol, 49, and both of his grandparents — Judy, 72, and Jim, 75 — all of Estevan.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. Consulate in Toronto fired upon for 2nd time this year, police seeking suspect vehicle
candidates.description: Police say the U.S. Consulate in Toronto, which was previously shot at in March, was again the target of gunfire Monday morning. Investigators say they pursued a suspect vehicle to the Don Valley Parkway immediately after the shooting, but called off the chase when it reached dangerous speeds.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Wildfire near Clinton, B.C., expected to grow as dry conditions, stronger winds approach
candidates.description: A fire burning near Clinton, B.C., is forcing more evacuations Monday, with the wildfire service saying "extreme fire behaviour" is expected on it this week.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: N.S. woman calls 911 to report erratic driver. Then a Mountie calls her from inside her home
candidates.description: Robin MacDougall says she "just couldn't comprehend" why police entered her home without her knowledge. RCMP say they visited the home because a 911 call was dropped and they were concerned about the caller's safety.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Fierté Montréal to step up security at Pride festivities after deadly attack in Berlin
candidates.description: Montreal Pride organizers say they will bolster security in response to the Berlin Pride attack that left one person dead and 29 injured over the weekend.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Jade across the Rockies: New research on stone celt artifacts helps map Indigenous trade routes
candidates.description: New research analyzing jade artifacts, unearthed east of the Rocky Mountains, sheds light on vast Indigenous trade networks that once cut across pre-colonial Western Canada.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Neskantaga First Nation calls on Ontario to communicate better amid wildfire emergency
candidates.description: Neskantaga First Nation’s chief and council are calling for better communications from the Provincial Emergency Operations Centre (PEOC) amid its ongoing state of emergency over the region’s wildfires. Here's what the community's chief wants to see done differently, and how the Ontario government has responded.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Some of B.C.'s biggest cities are using artificial intelligence — but what for?
candidates.description: Cities are exploring AI for a range of operational and administrative purposes, from summarizing reports and writing emails to early wildfire detection and identifying contaminated garbage.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Too small for its own police, an Alberta town eyes new provincial force
candidates.description: Rocky Mountain House is among small towns across the province considering making the switch from RCMP policing to the new Alberta Sheriffs Police Service. The new force offers a potential solution to lower costs and a desire to have town-focused policing.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: That condo storage locker you were sold? It might be illegal
candidates.description: Do storage lockers built directly into condo parking garages violate Ontario's fire code? Toronto Fire says yes. But a fire consultant describe a standards 'grey area' that's been going on for decades.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: New chair of Inuit Circumpolar Council calls for unity, relationship-building
candidates.description: Aluki Kotierk was acclaimed to the seat Saturday, taking the position over from Greenland chair Sara Olsvig who led the organization for the last four years.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 1 in 10 emergency physicians leaving Canadian ERs, national survey suggests
candidates.description: One out of every 10 emergency physicians in Canada have left their specialty, while the vast majority of others are reducing their hours or taking time off to manage burnout. The findings, part of a study out Monday in the Canadian Medical Association Journal, are based on a 2025 cross-country survey of hundreds of emergency medicine doctors.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: N.L.’s only managed alcohol consumption program set to end Friday
candidates.description: After four years, Newfoundland and Labrador's only managed alcohol consumption program will end on Friday due to a lack of sustainable funding from the province.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 122 active wildfires burning in northwestern Ontario
candidates.description: There are 122 active wildfires across northwestern Ontario, according to the latest update from Ontario's Aviation, Forest Fire and Emergency Services (AFFES) issued Sunday evening. Here's what we know about how they're affecting communities across the region.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Philanthropist behind Canadian human rights museum says family pausing funding over Palestinian exhibit
candidates.description: A philanthropist who played a critical role in bringing the Canadian Museum for Human Rights to Winipeg says her family is pausing any financial support for it over concerns around an exhibit on the displacement of Palestinians.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: In the age of AI, how do we teach young people to think critically?
candidates.description: How are we teaching critical thinking to students? Some want to see more explicit methods of guiding students from elementary through post-secondary to practise and build their critical thinking skills — and in spelling out why it's necessary.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Meteorites from viral June fireball event recovered from island in Lake Huron
candidates.description: Scientists with Western University's Meteor Physics Group have verified that the fragments recently recovered from Cockburn Island in northern Ontario are meteorites from June 19 fireball event.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Carney calls August byelections for 3 ridings in Ontario, Quebec and B.C.
candidates.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney has called three byelections in the B.C. riding of North Vancouver–Capilano, the Ontario riding of Beaches-East York and the Quebec riding of Chicoutimi—Le Fjord.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Huge fires in France and Spain force evacuation of 330,000 as another heat wave looms
candidates.description: Fire crews and planes are wrestling to bring a monster wildfire in southwest France under control before a forecast jump in temperatures complicates the firefighting effort.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: German chancellor Merz questions why suspect in Berlin Pride attack wasn't being monitored
candidates.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz vowed on Monday to take action in response to the fatal vehicle ramming attack on the Berlin Pride celebration over the weekend, with questions being asked as to why the suspected driver ​hadn't been in prison.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Saudi Arabia says it shot down Iranian drones targeting its oil facilities
candidates.description: Saudi Arabia, Jordan and Iraq reported drone attacks on Monday, two days after the United States abruptly suspended a ‌two-week campaign of airstrikes against Iran, as Tehran appeared to put U.S. President Donald Trump's latest strategic U-turn to the test.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: You're So Vain singer Carly Simon reveals Parkinson's disease and skin cancer diagnoses
candidates.description: Carly Simon says she’s finally ready to speak out about why she’s gone quiet in recent years. The singer who shot to fame in the 1970s with a string of hits that included You're So Vain has revealed she’s been diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease, while quietly battling basal cell carcinoma, a form of skin cancer.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Katy Perry slams White House for using her music in violent TikTok video
candidates.description: The 41-year-old pop star criticized the Trump administration on social media over the weekend for using one of her songs in a TikTok video.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Bill Oddie, of British comedy trio The Goodies, dead at 85
candidates.description: Bill Oddie, a British comic actor who had a second career as a bird expert and wildlife presenter, died on Saturday, his agent said. He was 85.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 3 killed, 4 injured in shooting at Seattle food festival
candidates.description: Police arrested one suspect and were looking for another after gunfire erupted at a crowded food festival beneath Seattle's Space Needle, leaving three people dead and four others injured, including a toddler.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: France wildfires creep toward wine city of Bordeaux
candidates.description: A raging wildfire in southwest France forced the evacuation of 55,000 people overnight Sunday, bringing the total forced out of their homes to a staggering 220,000 in one region alone as flames crept ever closer to the wine region city of Bordeaux.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S., Iran pause attacks for 2nd straight day
candidates.description: The U.S. paused its attacks on Iran for a second straight day on Sunday, and Tehran said it had done so, too, as efforts continued to bring the countries back to negotiations on an interim ceasefire deal largely undermined by recent exchanges of fire.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 2 mosques in the West Bank set on fire during a deadly surge in settler violence
candidates.description: Two mosques in the Israeli-occupied West Bank were set on fire overnight in an apparent Israeli settler attack, officials said Sunday, after a spate of deadly violence that killed four Palestinians and two Israeli soldiers.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Berlin Pride attack prompts grief, worry and solidarity with 2SLGBTQ+ community
candidates.description: Members of Berlin's 2SLGBTQ+ community and others voiced ‌grief, anger and solidarity on Sunday after a vehicle rammed into crowds at the city's annual Christopher Street Day Pride celebrations, killing one person and injuring 29.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Slovenia's Tadej Pogacar wins record-tying 5th Tour de France title
candidates.description: Tadej Pogacar won a record-equaling fifth Tour de France title on Sunday. The 27-year-old Slovenian dominated this year's race to join Belgian Eddy Merckx, Spaniard Miguel Indurain and Frenchmen Jacques Anquetil and Bernard Hinault as the only riders to win five Tours.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Suspect in deadly Berlin Pride attack killed in confrontation with police, officials say
candidates.description: The suspect in the deadly Berlin Pride attack that left one person dead and 29 injured was shot and killed by police during a confrontation on Sunday in a suburb of Germany's capital city, authorities said.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Prince George just turned 13. Why it’s a 'challenging time' for the 2nd in line to the throne
candidates.description: Prince George is at a point of major transition in his life, as the eldest child of the Prince and Princess of Wales sets off for boarding school in September and public interest grows in the second in line to the throne.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Scientists just found sugar in space. Here's why that matters
candidates.description: It's a sweet discovery that has the science world talking — and may help us better understand the origins of life on Earth.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: As Ebola cases in Congo near 3,000, more health workers go on strike
candidates.description: Health workers at an Ebola treatment centre in eastern Congo went on strike on Saturday, demanding their pay. The walkout disrupted care for patients in the epicentre of the country's rapidly growing outbreak.

candidates.description: A blaze near Bordeaux has torn through more than 162 sq miles (420 sq km) in less than four days, while the Madrid region is seeing its worst fires ever.

candidates.title: Ukraine dismisses Iranian threats as Caspian Sea strike directly links wars
candidates.description: Iran has reacted with fury to the assault on the vessel, with Tehran's foreign minister saying it "cannot go unanswered".
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Anger as Berlin Pride attacker revealed to have been freed weeks earlier
candidates.description: As details emerge about the suspected Berlin Pride attacker's past, many are asking why he was not in prison.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Shots fired at US consulate in Toronto for a second time this year
candidates.description: Police said they engaged in a high-speed car chase but failed to arrest the suspect, who remains at large. Three people were arrested in June after a similar attack.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Oil price dives as US and Iran pause attacks
candidates.description: The US says attacks on Iran have been halted to give "talks some space", raising hopes of a resolution to the conflict.

candidates.title: Chile captures fugitive convicted of singer Victor Jara's murder under Pinochet

candidates.title: Three dead and several injured in shooting at food festival near Seattle's Space Needle

candidates.title: Argentine leader calls Brazilian president a 'thief' and a 'convict'
candidates.description: Javier Milei spoke at a campaign rally for right-wing presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who is running against Lula.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Rapper Yung Filly tells trial 'vibes were good' with woman who accuses him of rape
candidates.description: The rapper takes the witness stand at his trial in Australia where he denies raping a fan in a hotel room.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Chinese chipmaker shares surge nearly 470% in blockbuster stock market debut

candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.description: The education minister's resignation, a rare setback for the Modi government, brings hope to many young protesters that their voices will be heard.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Musk takes 'crusade' to Europe with Armie Hammer film

candidates.title: What you need to know if you're travelling to France or Spain

candidates.title: Watch: Scaffolding tumbles from Hong Kong building as Typhoon Noul makes landfall

candidates.title: How to see July's full Buck Moon as it rises in the night sky

candidates.title: Baltimore will turn 911 into more than just an emergency number
candidates.description: Baltimore is rethinking what it means to call 911, and who responds. Callers who don't need police will get help finding social services and healthcare before they actually fall into crisis.

candidates.title: More than 2,000 measles cases reported in the U.S. so far, outpacing 2025's total
